name: Sherlock & Stock
tagline: Select any dates on a stock chart and get a plain-English, sourced explanation of what moved the price.
problem: Everyday investors cannot see why stocks move; analyst explanations are paywalled or full of jargon.
solution: Combines market data and news search with an LLM to explain a selected price move with sources and confidence.
demo_moment: Team-described: drag across a price drop and read why it happened.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “JT Award for Future Impact” among 124 submissions.
A judge-funded award for future impact.

lessons: Explaining a familiar chart with sources reads as democratizing expertise.
